pauseReason: The 730-day verification window and the hypothesis JSON field names are planning choices because the sources do not state them.

designRisks.summary: The age check has no day count in the sources, so a 730-day window can disagree with a later product number.
Hypothesis field names belong to a parallel ticket, so an unknown id key is skipped and prose measurements cannot show coverage.
The architecture validator has no checks for LangChain plus LangGraph and returned low confidence.

topPriorityItems.reason: A suitable dataset must be stored with the name, source URL, title, suitability, and hypothesis id.
A query match or an incomplete dataset must not be recorded as suitable.
Description match alone must never become a suitable registry entry.
Any failed suitability check must record unsuitable.
An unsuitable dataset must not be substituted as support for a hypothesis.
Human text must not enter this agent.
A registry entry without identity fields cannot be traced to a hypothesis.
